game.name: Super Mario Bros. 3
game.rules:
1. Anything not possible on an original and unmodified NES, brick controller, and SMB3 cartridge is prohibited for runs. This includes but is not limited to:  
-turbo,
-left+right,
-savestates,
-using a non-official rom (including fan translations),
-speeding up gameplay,
-rewind (such as on the Switch virtual console),
-using runahead on emulators.

2. When starting a new run, you must go to the title screen through means of a soft or hard reset. This means that NG+ type runs are not allowed, which includes starting a run on the title screen with RAM storage or an inventory full of p-wings after previously beating the game + pressing start after credits.

3. Run highlights should be posted to YouTube or Twitch, videos from any other site will most likely be rejected. Make sure that the video won't automatically expire (e.g. a twitch broadcast) and create permanent highlights instead.

4. The full run must be seen in the submission video (beginning and start points can't be cut off whatsoever). It is encouraged that the moments before your run are also included, such as the end of the previous run that you reset on.

5. Please submit runs with audible in-game sound or else they will possibly be rejected.

6. Application features that read data live (like but not limited to lag frames), which provide a benefit or stimulii to the runner (like but not limited to an audio cue or visual cue), after the run has started, in order to exploit the game via in-app calculations (like but not limited to reverse engineered game logic or rng calculations) are banned
7. Banned emulators: ZSNES (any version), SNES9x 1.4x.
8. Banned consoles: RetroN 1 (at least but not limited to HD+AV), Polystation. (Note: All inaccurate clone console submissions will be rejected.)

Be sure to check the category-specific rules for whatever you plan on running, especially for any% where the rules are most strict.

See [SRC moderator guidelines](https://www.speedrun.com/support/learn/moderation-rules) and reach out directly if you observe discrepancies.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ADDITIONAL EMULATOR RULES:
For high-level runners of this game playing on emulator, there are additional rules that you must follow when running. New players don't necessarily need to worry about any of this, but it is still encouraged that anyone takes a look at this document to be aware of the time thresholds where these rules will be relevant.

[SMB3 Submission Rules for Emulator](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nlTTikgNzxKKUOXY3IHpp7ymNtPb2VWAhUnDWsE7wFk)

categories.rules:
*Please click the "Game Rules" tab above to view the rules applying for every category.*

Beat the game, entering and completing every stage and Hammer Bros. fight.

Time starts on pressing Start on the title screen.
Time ends on entering the door after defeating Bowser, which is exactly 5 frames before the screen begins to fade.
Please only submit milliseconds if you're tied with a top 3 time.

This category includes:
_ All action stages (numbered stages, fortresses, airships, plants, hands...)
_ All overworld Hammer Bros. (including their Boomerang, Fire and Sledge Bros. variations)

Important notes:
_ Do not forget the Fire Bros. behind the rock in world 2, the two plants in world 7 and the three hands in world 8!
_ If you accidentally transform some Hammer Bros. into a coinship, you must either beat the coinship or die on purpose during the coinship to transform it back into Hammer Bros. and then defeat them.
_ Mushroom houses, card games, roulette games and overworld pipes are allowed but not required.

categories.name: Any% Warpless
categories.rules:
*Please click the "Game Rules" tab above to view the rules applying for every category.*

Beat the game as quickly as possible without using any wrong warps or warp whistles. Warp whistles may be collected but not used.

Time starts on pressing Start on the title screen.
Time ends on entering the door after defeating Bowser, which is exactly 5 frames before the screen begins to fade.
Please only submit milliseconds if you're tied with a top 3 time.

The "Hands" option when submitting is referring to the 3 hand stages in world 8, and if you do not know what early hammer is, leave it on "No". The amount of hands counted in a submission is based on hand stages that have been completed after beating the air force, rather than the amount of times you have been grabbed.

Note: EH manipulation is allowed for emulator and console

*Note that RetroArch with Nestopia UE or FCEUMM cores are allowed*

*Note that Mesen-RTA versions >=0.0.7 are allowed*

If you're playing on emulator, please indicate which one you used in the description.
If you're playing on RetroArch, please also indicate which core you are using in the description.
